messages.body: DL-016 cannot be placed in Copperfin Locker because all suitable compartments are occupied. The parcel remains in depot stock. We can offer staffed Sedgeglass Counter or retry the locker after two days.
I need the parcel before the locker retry date. Please send me the carrier’s alternative collection option.
Please offer Zerin the available staffed Sedgeglass Counter option through the verified order thread and obtain their choice before routing DL-016.
Zerin accepted Sedgeglass Counter at 09:42 UTC. We transferred DL-016; the counter’s 15:05 receipt scan confirms it is ready until 2026-02-20, 18:00 UTC.
I accepted Sedgeglass Counter this morning, but the notice I just received says DL-016 is ready at Copperfin Locker, compartment 12. Which location actually has my parcel?

Zerin has received a notice that DL-016 is ready at Copperfin Locker, compartment 12, while your 15:05 UTC counter receipt scan places it at Sedgeglass Counter. We are keeping both records. Which location physically holds DL-016? Please send a current scan and correct whichever notice is wrong.

Sedgeglass Counter rescanned DL-016 at 15:55 UTC; it is there. The Copperfin Locker notice was sent in error and is withdrawn. We sent Zerin a corrected ready notice for Sedgeglass Counter at 16:05 UTC. This settles readiness, not collection.
